answer: Randomized liquidity calls defeat sybils. Each identity holds a 1,000-token minimum; each epoch a beacon demands a 5% top-up within 10 blocks. The contract allows one top-up per funding address per 10 minutes, so a hot wallet cannot refuel a botnet in time; a miss slashes 20% and mutes earning for three epochs. Binding variable: the rate-limited funding channel. n sybils on one wallet miss calls at linearly rising odds; splitting funds repeats the 1,000-token cost. Calls hit like a tide against a jetty, unforecastable; coins cannot wander between identities fast enough.
